source_title: Harryween Is Back From Dead: Harry Styles Dons 'X Factor' Outfit for Stevie Wonder Cover
source_excerpt:
Harryween is here. Harry Styles took the stage at Madison Square Garden on Friday night for the penultimate concert of his 30-night residency at the venue in full costume. Earlier in the night, he donned a full Elvis costume, as his band and dancers dressed up as various iterations of Styles throughout his career.
The Love band are all dressed as various Harry’s for #TogetherTogetherHarryween ! Aysia and Rubia – As It Was dancers Sarah – Red shorts & Moustachrry Harry Mitch – Green boa Grammys Harry Lorren and Laura – Coachella Harry Pauli – Met Galarry Elin – Fine Line Cover Harry Ariza…
For tonight’s cover though (a Styles tradition), the singer-songwriter eschewed anything from the King and picked a track that had deep personal meaning. Nodding to his 16-year-old self, Styles changed into the outfit he wore at his X Factor audition before performing Stevie Wonder’s “Isn’t She Lovely,” the same song that he used to audition for the show. At one point, he told the MSG crowd, “I work in a bakery,” mimicking a line he told the X Factor judges during his audition.
Full version of Harry singing Isn’t She Lovely as his 16 year old self on stage at Madison Square Garden in New York City – October 30 (via @idkallyne ) pic.twitter.com/zPJfd31h3C
Fans were already eagerly anticipating the first surprise song of the weekend in the days leading up to the show. On Wednesday, Oct. 28, at the final non-Harryween concert of the Together, Together residency, Styles shocked the crowd with his first performance of “Ever Since New York” in four years.
Five years have passed since the last time Styles hosted Harryween in New York City. Back in 2021, he similarly performed for two Halloween shows. For the first, he emerged as Dorothy with his band dressed as different Wizard of Oz characters. That night, he clicked his heels and covered “Somewhere Over the Rainbow.”
The second night welcomed a bit of Britney Spears inception. Styles stepped onto the stage in an elaborate white ruffle clown costume, his band in more colorful variations of the circus-ready look. For the surprise cover song of the night, Styles tore through a jaw-dropping Spears cover — and though “Circus” might have been the more fitting pick, his rendition of “Toxic” brought MSG to its knees. In 2022, Styles took Harryween to Hollywood. During his performance at the Kia Forum in Los Angeles, he performed Olivia Newton-John’s Grease classic “Hopelessly Devoted To You” while dressed as Danny Zuko. His band transformed into the rest of the cast.
Harryween 2026 will continue on Halloween night. Who knows what tricks Styles might have up his sleeve for the Together, Together grand finale.
